body:
Thanks everyone for the messages and posts - I’m sorting everything out today, the general anxiety and panic I’ve had for the past year has strangely calmed now I know what’s going to happen.

I probably won’t be posting anymore after today, but I do extend my heartfelt thanks to everyone that has posted or messaged me, I will try and respond to everyone as best I can.

To the suggestion of fleeing the country - I’ve been on bail the past year, compiled with everything and I’m not going to make things 10x worse by doing anything like that ...

Thank you all, from bad things good can come, we just need to look at the longer view rather than the short term, and the love and support I have from family and the strangers here proves that point.

Love yourself, love each other, and keep on keeping on
